how to load a patient appointment details in billing screen

For viewing all the appointments for today, click on the button near ‘Appointment no’. Double click on the appointment number, then the patient, doctor and token booked details will automatically be loaded.

what are the fields required for service billing form?

The fields required for the service billing form are: 1. File Type - mandatory field 2. Category - mandatory field 3. Service - mandatory field 4. File No - mandatory field 5. Estimate No - optional field (not explicitly stated as mandatory in the provided context).
